data.body:
Landed as Gerrit change 1667 (MERGED as 1debc5e3d4; LLM-Review +1, Verified +1).

AC1 — the exclude append is now ONE `os.write` to an O_APPEND descriptor, atomic at end-of-file on POSIX (the project's declared support surface: pyproject classifies POSIX/macOS only, all CI is ubuntu-latest). Honest scoping: the prior buffered two-write append merely happened to coalesce under CPython buffering, so this makes the guarantee explicit rather than incidental to a buffering policy — it is not a claim the old code was observably tearing. Duplicate WHOLE lines remain possible and are documented as the deliberate disposition (git applies a repeated pattern identically; de-duplicating would need a lock this function must not take, as it runs before the write lock by design). Pinned by a 16-worker/32-call concurrency test asserting per-line integrity.

AC2 — four failure oracles added: exclusion-write failure (strict typed `stage-failed` vs warn-and-return) and `git status` failure, the latter folded into the existing stage/commit parametrize so all three locked-phase failures share one oracle. Each asserts content retained, no push attempted, and a clean retry delivering.

AC3 — a real legacy-tracker commit asserts via `git ls-tree -r` that no `.ticket-write.lock*` path reaches the committed TREE. The artifacts are NOT planted (they ARE the write lock — planting them just blocks it, which an earlier draft proved by deadlocking for 181s); they exist for real during the locked `git add -A`, and a probe asserts they were present at that moment so the oracle cannot pass vacuously.

AC4 — 176 passed / 3 skipped across the push-related unit suites; make lint and make typecheck pass; push.py is 799 lines, inside the 800 module-size gate.

RED evidence: neutering the exclusion install turns all three new tests red, the legacy one with exactly the hazard — 'reserved lock artifacts entered the committed tree'.

Scope note: `lock.py` and `transition_close.py` were deliberately untouched (concurrent lock-family work), so this change is confined to push.py plus its held-out test file.
